name: kioku-search
description: Long-term memory for AI coding agents: keeps lessons from successes and failures and shares them across chats. A claude-mem fork with offline search, bundled for Windows x64.

scripts.check: node --check extension.cjs && node --check runtime.cjs && node --check mcp-provider.cjs && node --check copilot.cjs && node --check local-summary.cjs && node --check language.cjs && node --check media/sidebar.js

kioku.language.description: Language of the kioku sidebar. English by default. It can also be switched from the sidebar.

kioku.copilotEnabled.description: OFF (default): local extractive script summaries with no AI credit consumption. ON: explicit, confirmed GitHub Copilot summaries, subject to your plan and model usage limits.

kioku.workerUrl.description: Local kioku worker URL. Leave empty to detect the existing kioku settings and installation port. Only HTTP loopback addresses are allowed.
